name: ZENTECH
recent: Zen Tech 近期面临外部审计师因未付审计费而辞职，同时有一项重大诉讼在进行中。公司还宣布了多项提案，并发布了最新季度财报，显示收入环比增长但同比下滑，仍处于亏损状态。
notable: 外部审计师因未付审计费而辞职。
公司宣布多项提案（具体内容未提供）。
risks: 外部审计师辞职可能影响财务报告进程。
重大诉讼可能带来财务或运营影响。
公司最新季度仍录得净亏损。
earnings: 截至2026年6月30日的季度，收入为1134.1万令吉，环比增长10.0%，但同比下降17.1%；净亏损116.8万令吉，净利率为-10.3%，较上一季度的-96.1%有所改善。

recent_en: Zen Tech recently faced the resignation of its external auditor over unpaid audit fees, while a material litigation is ongoing. The company also announced multiple proposals and released its latest quarterly results, showing QoQ revenue growth but a YoY decline, remaining in loss.
notable_en: External auditor resigned over unpaid audit fees.
The company announced multiple proposals (details not provided).
The company is involved in material litigation.
risks_en: The auditor's resignation may affect financial reporting processes.
Material litigation may have financial or operational impact.
The company remained in net loss in the latest quarter.
earnings_en: For the quarter ended 30 June 2026, revenue was MYR 11.341 million, up 10.0% QoQ but down 17.1% YoY; net loss was MYR 1.168 million with a net margin of -10.3%, improved from -96.1% in the previous quarter.
